facts.F1: Story #6360 S03b Package Work Items, nwdes feature A of three (rules first). Before any Work Items type moves into Modules/WorkItems, make every architecture rule that names Work Items' namespaces, folders, paths or types also see Modules/WorkItems, fix the membership list from the compiled code, and add a safety net that shows a refresh gives the same items, transitions, blocks and events. Behaviour-free: routes, DTOs, responses, refresh results and metrics stay the same. Design: docs/feature/story-6360-s03b-package-work-items/feature-delta.md (slices A1-A3, Ratchet design, D-1, D-10).

facts.F13: Behaviour-free, test-side and script-side only: no production type moves, no route, DTO, response, schema, refresh result, metrics answer, DI lifetime or handler order changes. Every rule reads the compiled IL through IlDependencies or the ArchUnitNET production architecture; inline lists stay two-way (InlineBaseline); no rule is loosened. DomainEventHandlerOrderPinTest stays green unmodified.
facts.F14: Shared rules owner: ModuleRules and ModuleWording (Architecture folder) are reused; no rule is copied and no second rules class is created. KernelRules and ApplicationCoreRules already treat Modules as application core and need no change.
facts.F15: Made-up types live in the test assembly below Lighthouse.Backend.Modules.WorkItems (for example Lighthouse.Backend.Modules.WorkItems.Application.WorkItemsFixtures), with a compliant twin each and a namesake just outside the module (Lighthouse.Backend.Modules.WorkItemsFixtures), the S03c way: the widened patterns end in (\.|$), so only a type below Modules.WorkItems proves the real widened constant.
facts.F16: Formal verification: no checker selected, no model written or run. No state, transition, protocol, concurrency or recovery behaviour changes. Rule and membership claims are finite and decided exactly by the compiled IL with a made-up offender as falsifier; the refresh-preservation claim compares the code with itself, so literal expected values at the service port are the honest falsifier. Liveness not applicable: synchronous rule evaluation and a one-shot capture have no progress property. Property-based testing not applicable: every law is a finite enumeration of rules, types, refresh scenarios and named endpoints; the test-writing skill decides test density.
facts.F17: Carriers, all test-side: rule verdicts are KernelRuleVerdict, InboundVerdict and OutboundVerdict owned by ModuleRules and KernelRules; dependency facts are IlDependent from IlDependencies; per-fixture state is the lazily read Mono.Cecil ModuleDefinition disposed at one-time teardown; the refresh oracle holds a ServicePortHarness per scenario; the compare script holds captured bodies in a temp directory. Layers: application rules only; no adapter, infrastructure or recovery layer changes.

Which reactions are observable through the public API without a premium licence: unknown, measured by the S3 crafter; any reaction with no public observation is named in the command output as not observable rather than claimed.
